headlines.title: Trump took a secret flight out of Turkey in an elaborate plot to hide his location amid the Iran war
headlines.description: The operation last month used a catering truck to get the president on the C-32 that flew from Ankara to Royal Air Force Mildenhall in the U.K.

headlines.title: Ex-Marine freed from Russian prison after Trump discussed case with Putin
headlines.description: A former U.S. Marine who spent more than four years in a Russian prison and is believed to be seriously ill has been released and was on his way back to the United States. President Donald Trump announced the release of Robert Gilman after he discussed the case with Russian President Vladimir Putin. NBC News' Keir Simmons reports.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania ‘odd couple’ Fetterman & McCormick eager to build bipartisan relationship
headlines.description: The growing relationship between Sen. John Fetterman (D-Pa.) and Sen. David McCormick (R-Pa.) continues to raise eyebrows in Washington after the pair announced a joint fundraising committee. NBC News political reporter Allan Smith takes a look at the duo’s relationship.

headlines.title: Kornacki previews ‘topsy turvy’ Wisconsin gubernatorial race between Francesca Hong & David Crowley
headlines.description: NBC News Chief Data Analyst Steve Kornacki previews the key primary races in Wisconsin and South Carolina. NBC News correspondent Shaq Brewster and WTMJ Chief Political reporter Charles Benson discuss fight between progressive and establishment Democrats in Wisconsin. NBC News correspondent Ryan Nobles reports from South Carolina on the state of play in the race to replace the late Senator Lindsey Graham.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Trump’s ICE crackdown returns to the spotlight as the midterms loom: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki digs into the perilous immigration politics facing the Trump administration and the GOP. Plus, we preview the key races to watch as primary results roll in this evening.

headlines.title: Judge finds Kennedy Center owes musician $250,000 in legal fees
headlines.description: A judge in Washington, D.C., dismissed the center’s suit against Chuck Redd for canceling a concert after the president’s name was added to the facade.

headlines.title: Lauren Boebert’s 21-year-old son is arrested on child sexual exploitation charges
headlines.description: The allegations are linked to a video Tyler Boebert, then 18, is accused of recording in 2024 with a 17-year-old.

headlines.title: Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs chooses former Republican as running mate in re-election bid
headlines.description: Democratic Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs has chosen a former Republican as her running mate for her re-election bid this November.

headlines.title: Jennifer Balkcom picked to replace Rep. Chuck Edwards in N.C. congressional race
headlines.description: Edwards dropped his re-election bid after the House Ethics Committee recommended he be censured over sexual harassment allegations. He has denied any wrongdoing.

headlines.title: Trump signs executive order aiming to cut the number of required vaccines for children
headlines.description: The order reaffirms the dramatic overhaul to the vaccine schedule that Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced this year. Those changes have been blocked in court.

headlines.title: Recount puts Trump-backed challenger in the lead in Indiana state Senate primary
headlines.description: State Sen. Spencer Deery, who now trails Republican Paula Copenhaver by three votes, said he will appeal.
